findings.issue: research.json 的 note 称快照正文有「A care coordinator on a 150 to 200 patient panel actively manages the top 5%」以及「Worklist refreshed / Action status tracked」；按 REVIEW_SOURCES 指定的 sources/6e9d199354215fc403122105cc9f9c1cd7fdab685d51385d3decaee9307a2c00.txt 逐字检索不到这些句子。该快照可见的正文是 reads every value-based contract、assigns a value to every action、Agents work the routine steps、Your team owns the exceptions，以及 34% average gap closure 等统计；batch.leaf_matches.reason 仍写「正文列出…工作清单刷新/行动状态跟踪」，属于把产品预览或推断当作正文。快照也未明确给出 defined/attributed population 或 person-level registry，Innovaccer 作为 PHM 案例的核心证据不足。
findings.fix: 删除未核到的引文和「工作清单刷新」等表述，只保留可逐字核到的合同—行动优先级、代理执行常规步骤、团队处理例外、gap-closure/outreach 统计；若要保留 Innovaccer 为 PHM 案例，补充能证明 attributed/empaneled population 与 person-level registry 的官方页面并加入 REVIEW_SOURCES，否则将其从 leaf_matches 移除，由 Azara 支撑该叶。

findings.issue: batch.leaf_matches.reason 与 research.note 引用帮助文章快照中的「Choose Review Note」「You can edit content and add ICD-10 codes」「When the EHR is back online, send the note」；但 sources/24648dab0d28c369b5f6c4f213b681e4bc4eb41556f89c39366a8a0389e8f962.txt 只有 73 行，正文是空的 Next.js/Intercom 壳，只有 title、meta 和结构化数据，未包含这些句子。该快照不能作为审阅—编辑—发送闭环的正文证据。
findings.fix: 重新抓取并保存能加载正文的帮助文章，或改引 Suki Solutions 快照中可核到的 structured notes / syncing to the EHR 段落，并从 reason/note 删除无法在快照中核到的引文；Suki 案例可保留，但证据链须以实际快照为准。

skilled-nursing-facility-management.basis: PointClickCare 云端 SNF 平台正文含 resident status 跟踪、insurance coverage validation、MDS 自动提交 iQIES、billing/accounts receivable/collections/claims、trust fund、care plans；Increase Occupancy 快照含 census-mix、occupancy、admission decisions。MatrixCare 快照含 SNF 软件、billing/RCM、census 与 financial accounts receivable 报告、MDS assessments。

clinical-communication-platform.basis: PerfectServe 快照含 Dynamic Intelligent Routing 使用 real-time schedules、roles、coverage、clinical context；Message escalation 与 unanswered messages climb the chain；audit trail 记录 every message、delivery event、sign-in；Connect 页含 patient context、attachments、delivery tracking、read receipts。Spok 快照含 provider directory、EHR、on-call schedules 集成，按 people/groups/roles 查找，confirmed delivery、intelligent escalation、audit-ready records。

clinical-documentation-platform.basis: Abridge 快照含 structured specialty-specific note ready for review、editing tools/time-to-sign、finalized notes ready for review/billing/follow-up、EHR workflows。Suki Solutions 快照含 ambient capture、structured notes、edit before EHR sync 等正文。
